svg.desc: Shared finance rules: lib/finance and its backend mirror. 20 components in 3 groups. Connections: useDashboardMetrics to dashboardMetrics (calls); useDashboardMetrics to investmentFlows (calls); useTaxPlanning to taxHistory (calls); useTaxPlanning to taxPlanning (calls); useNetWorth to netWorth (calls); useNetWorth to monthlyAverage (calls); useGoalsState to monthlyAverage (calls); Health score analysis to monthlyAverage (month spine); Health score analysis to metricRules.ts (essentials); useSpendingAnalysis to spending (calls); spending to monthlyAverage (month spine); useIncomeAnalysis to incomeMetrics (calls); Returns, investments to investmentReturns (calls); Returns, investments to investmentFlows (calls); investmentFlows to metricRules.ts (phrasePattern); taxHistory to metricRules.ts (salary vs bonus); metricRules.ts to metric_rules.py (mirrors); metric_rules.py to Analytics engine (classify).

text.tspan: SHARED FINANCE RULES: LIB/FINANCE AND ITS BACKEND MIRROR
Page hooks call pure lib/finance modules; metricRules.ts and metric_rules.py hold the same matchers, kept in step by hand
